questions.question: Relation $R(A,B,C)$ has FDs $A \to B$ and $B \to C$. The highest normal form of $R$ is:
questions.solution: $A^+ = \{A,B,C\}$, so $A$ is the only key. There is no partial dependency (the key is a single attribute), so $R$ is in 2NF. But $B \to C$ has a non-prime $C$ and non-superkey $B$ (a transitive dependency), so it is not in 3NF.
